title: Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation
description: Investigate a Kobalos Linux backdoor on a target host, identify C2 server IP and port, and check for lateral movement.
outcomes: Analyze system logs and configuration files
Determine C2 server IP and port

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The provided MISP event describes a high confidence Linux/Kobalos backdoor that targets high performance computing infrastructure. The malware is portable to multiple operating systems, including Linux, BSD, Solaris, and possibly AIX and Windows.

levels.title: Access Target Host
levels.cloud_content: Use the provided Ansible playbook to set up the target host with SSH access.
levels.local_content: Connect to the target host using SSH.

levels.title: Analyze Target Host for IOCs
levels.content: Analyze the target host's logs, configuration files, and system state to identify any signs of malicious activity related to Kobalos.
levels.solution: Examine sshd logs for unusual connections, failed login attempts, or other suspicious activities. Check system files and configuration settings for any signs of malware presence or persistence mechanisms.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Start by examining the sshd logs for unusual connections, failed login attempts, or other suspicious activities.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Check system files and configuration settings for any signs of malware presence or persistence mechanisms.

reference_solution.state_name: Check system files and configuration settings

levels.title: Identify C2 Server IP and Port
levels.content: Verify that the obtained C2 IP address and port match those provided in the MISP event (151.80.57.191, 7070).
levels.solution: Analyze network traffic or system logs to find connections to the C2 server.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Examine network traffic for connections to the C2 server.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Check system logs for any malware-related artifacts that could provide clues about the C2 communication.

levels.title: Check for Lateral Movement
levels.content: Determine if there is lateral movement within the network by checking for signs of Kobalos activity on the next-target host.
levels.solution: Examine system files, configuration settings, and network traffic to find any signs of malicious activity related to Kobalos. Additionally, check for any unusual SSH connections between the target and next-target hosts.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Examine system files, configuration settings, and network traffic to find any signs of malicious activity related to Kobalos.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Check for any unusual SSH connections between the target and next-target hosts.

reference_solution.state_name: Check system files and configuration settings
